name: Volkner
card_text: Choose 1 of your Electivire or Luxray. Attach 2 [ L ] Energy from your discard pile to that Pokémon.

name: Dawn
card_text: Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Mars
card_text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws a card for each of their remaining points needed to win.

name: Tangrowth

1.name: Mega Drain
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Combee

1.name: Call for Family
1.effect: Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Carnivine

1.name: Flog
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Shaymin

ability.name: Fragrant Flower Garden
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Mamoswine

ability.name: Thick Fat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks from [R] or [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Gastrodon

1.name: Muddy Water
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: They normally inhabit rocky seashores, but in times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be found in the mountains, far from the sea.

name: Manaphy

1.name: Oceanic Gift
1.effect: Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Shinx

1.name: Hide
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Rotom

1.name: Assault Laser
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Drifloon

1.name: Expand
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Mesprit

1.name: Supreme Blast
1.effect: You can use this attack only if you have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench. Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Giratina

ability.name: Levitate
ability.effect: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Cresselia

1.name: Moonlight Gain
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Rhyperior

1.name: Mountain Swing
1.effect: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

flavour_text: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

name: Lucario

ability.name: Fighting Coach
ability.effect: Attacks used by your [F] Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Hippopotas
flavour_text: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

name: Spiritomb

1.name: Swirling Disaster
1.effect: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Croagunk

1.name: Group Beatdown
1.effect: Flip a coin for each Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Heatran

1.name: Steel Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Garchomp

ability.name: Reckless Shearing
ability.effect: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.

flavour_text: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Staraptor

1.name: Clutch
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof

1.name: Super Fang
1.effect: Halve your opponent's Active Pokémon's remaining HP, rounded down.

flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Glameow

1.name: Pose
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

name: Regigigas

1.name: Raging Hammer
1.effect: This attack does more damage equal to the damage this Pokémon has on it.

flavour_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

1.name: Air Slash
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.

1.name: Flare Blitz
1.effect: Discard all [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

2.name: Dimensional Storm
2.effect: Discard 3 [W] Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

1.name: Sparking Gadget
1.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

1.name: Magical Delusion
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

1.name: Energized Blade
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

1.name: Scratching Nails
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 40 more damage.

ability.name: Nightmare Aura
ability.effect: Whenever you attach a [D] Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

1.name: Metallic Turbo
1.effect: Take 2 [M] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

1.name: Licking Fury
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

name: Cyrus
card_text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it to the Active Spot.
